about: YouTube videos that rebuild a song's beat, for students to copy into the Drum Machines page and export as JSON. Each video confirmed to exist with YouTube oEmbed on 2026-11-25 (title and channel as YouTube gives them). Whether a video uses the real machine, a clone or software is as its title says, not checked.
